arxiv-2010-04482.title: Word Level Language Identification in English Telugu Code Mixed Data
arxiv-2010-04482.creator: Sunil Gundapu, Radhika Mamidi
arxiv-2010-04482.description: Abstract In a multilingual or sociolingual configuration Intra-sentential Code Switching (ICS) or Code Mixing (CM) is frequently observed nowadays. In the world most of the people know more than one language. The CM usage is especially apparent in social media platforms.

arxiv-2102-01470.title: Lax Connections in T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} -deformed Integrable Field Theories
arxiv-2102-01470.creator: Bin Chen, Jue Hou, Jia Tian
arxiv-2102-01470.description: Abstract In this work, we try to construct the Lax connections of T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} -deformed integrable field theories in two different ways. With reasonable assumptions, we make ansatz and find the Lax pairs in the T ​ T ¯ T\bar{T} -deformed affine Toda theories and the principal chiral model by solving the Lax equations directly.

arxiv-2110-14730.title: Impact of Schumann resonances on the Einstein Telescope and projections for the magnetic coupling function
arxiv-2110-14730.creator: Kamiel Janssens, Katarina Martinovic, Nelson Christensen, Patrick M. Meyers, Mairi Sakellariadou
arxiv-2110-14730.description: Abstract Correlated magnetic noise in the form of Schumann resonances could introduce limitations to the gravitational-wave background searches of future Earth-based gravitational-wave detectors. We consider recorded magnetic activity at a candidate site for the Einstein Telescope, and forecast the necessary measures to ensure that magnetic contamination will not pose a threat to the science goals of this third-generation detector.

arxiv-2202-01231.title: Interaction Enabled Fractonic Higher-Order Topological Phases
arxiv-2202-01231.creator: Julian May-Mann, Yizhi You, Taylor L. Hughes, Zhen Bi
arxiv-2202-01231.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Julian May-Mann, Yizhi You, Taylor L. Hughes, Zhen Bi. In this work, we present a collection of three-dimensional higher-order symmetry protected topological phases (HOSPTs) with gapless hinge modes that exist only in strongly interacting systems subject to subsystem symmetry constraints. We use a coupled wire construction to generate three families of microscopic lattice models: insulators with helical hinge modes, superconductors with chiral Majorana hinge modes, and fractionalized insulators with helical hinge modes that carry fractional charge.

arxiv-2205-06417.title: A Journey from Wild to Textbook Data to Reproducibly Refresh the Wages Data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth Database
arxiv-2205-06417.creator: Dewi Amaliah, Dianne Cook, Emi Tanaka, Kate Hyde, Nicholas Tierney
arxiv-2205-06417.description: Abstract Textbook data is essential for teaching statistics and data science methods because they are clean, allowing the instructor to focus on methodology. Ideally textbook data sets are refreshed regularly, especially when they are subsets taken from an on-going data collection.

arxiv-2212-03995.title: Phase Coexistence Implications of Violating Newton’s Third Law
arxiv-2212-03995.creator: Yu-Jen Chiu, Ahmad K. Omar
arxiv-2212-03995.description: Abstract Newton’s third law, action = reaction , is a foundational statement of classical mechanics. However, in natural and living systems, this law appears to be routinely violated for constituents interacting in a nonequilibrium environment. Here, we use computer simulations to explore the macroscopic phase behavior implications of breaking microscopic interaction reciprocity for a simple model system.

arxiv-2308-14656.title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range 𝟒𝟏 ​ – ​ 𝟕𝟒 ​ 𝝁 ​ 𝐞𝐕 \mathbf{41\text{--}74}\,\bm{\mu}\mathbf{eV} using Millimeter-Wave Receiver and Radioshielding Box
arxiv-2308-14656.creator: S. Adachi, R. Fujinaka, S. Honda, Y. Muto, H. Nakata, Y. Sueno, T. Sumida, J. Suzuki, O. Tajima, H. Takeuchi, DOSUE-RR Collaboration
arxiv-2308-14656.description: Abstract Dark photons have been considered potential candidates for dark matter. The dark photon dark matter (DPDM) has a mass and interacts with electromagnetic fields via kinetic mixing with a coupling constant of χ \chi . Thus, DPDMs are converted into ordinary photons at metal surfaces.

arxiv-2311-18364.title: Hubness Reduction Improves Sentence-BERT Semantic Spaces
arxiv-2311-18364.creator: Beatrix M. G. Nielsen, Lars Kai Hansen
arxiv-2311-18364.description: Abstract Semantic representations of text, i.e. representations of natural language which capture meaning by geometry, are essential for areas such as information retrieval and document grouping. High-dimensional trained dense vectors have received much attention in recent years as such representations.

arxiv-2407-08091.title: Programming Language Case Studies Can Be Deep
arxiv-2407-08091.creator: Rose Bohrer
arxiv-2407-08091.description: Abstract In the pedagogy of programming languages, one well-known course structure is to tour multiple languages as a means of touring paradigms. This tour-of-paradigms approach has long received criticism as lacking depth, distracting students from foundational issues in language theory and implementation. This paper argues for disentangling the idea of a tour-of-languages from the tour-of-paradigms.

arxiv-2503-10385.title: An Algebraic Foundation for Knowledge Graph Construction Thanks: This is an extended version of a research paper accepted for the 22nd Extended Semantic Web Conference (ESWC 2025). The extension consists of a few additional equivalences in Section 6.1 and the complete content of Section 6.2 , which
arxiv-2503-10385.creator: Sitt Min Oo, Olaf Hartig
arxiv-2503-10385.description: Abstract Although they exist since more than ten years already, have attracted diverse implementations, and have been used successfully in a significant number of applications, declarative mapping languages for constructing knowledge graphs from heterogeneous types of data sources still lack a solid formal foundation.

arxiv-2504-19767.title: Crafting a Personal Journaling Practice: Negotiating Ecosystems of Materials, Personal Context, and Community in Analog Journaling
arxiv-2504-19767.creator: Katherine Lin, Juna Kawai-Yue, Adira Sklar, Lucy Hecht, Sarah Sterman, Tiffany Tseng
arxiv-2504-19767.description: Abstract . Analog journaling has grown in popularity, with journaling on paper encompassing a range of motivations, styles, and practices including planning, habit-tracking, and reflecting. Journalers develop strong personal preferences around the tools they use, the ideas they capture, and the layout in which they represent their ideas and memories.

arxiv-2506-05737.title: Search for Lorentz Invariance Violation with spectral lags of GRB 190114C using profile likelihood
arxiv-2506-05737.creator: Vyaas Ramakrishnan, Shantanu Desai
arxiv-2506-05737.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vyaas Ramakrishnan, Shantanu Desai. We search for Lorentz invariance violation (LIV) using the spectral lag data for GRB 190114C using frequentist analysis, where we deal with the astrophysical nuisance parameters using profile likelihood. For this use case, we find a global minima for the χ 2 \chi^{2} as a function of energy scale of LIV ( E Q ​ G E_{QG} ), well below the Planck scale.

arxiv-2508-02965.title: Novel measures and estimators of income inequality
arxiv-2508-02965.creator: Roberto Vila 1 and Helton Saulo 1,2 1 Department of Statistics, University of Brasilia, Brasilia, Brazil 2 Department of Economics, Federal University of Pelotas, Pelotas, Brazil
arxiv-2508-02965.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose new income inequality measures that approximate the Gini coefficient and analyze the asymptotic properties of their estimators, including strong consistency and limiting distribution. Generalizations to the measures and estimators are developed. Simulation studies assess finite-sample performance, and an empirical example demonstrates practical relevance. Keywords. Income inequality measures \cdot Monte Carlo simulation \cdot R software.

arxiv-2509-12370.title: Efficient Entanglement Purification Circuit Design for Dual-Species Atom Arrays
arxiv-2509-12370.creator: Bikun Li, Daniel Dilley, Alvin Gonzales, Thomas A. Hahn, Rotem Arnon, Hannes Bernien, Zain Saleem, Liang Jiang
arxiv-2509-12370.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bikun Li, Daniel Dilley, Alvin Gonzales, Thomas A. Hahn, Rotem Arnon, Hannes Bernien, Zain Saleem, Liang Jiang. Entanglement purification protocols (EPPs) are essential for generating high-fidelity entangled states in noisy quantum systems, enabling robust quantum networking and computation. Building on the circuit of the foundational recurrence protocol, we generalize two-way EPPs to arbitrary stabilizer codes. Through analytical derivations and noisy circuit simulations incorporating circuit-level noise, we demonstrate enhanced purification performance, with fidelity improvements and finite distillation rates for distillable input states.

arxiv-2512-14071.title: Spiral-induced Anomalous Hall Effect from Odd-parity Spin-nodal Lines
arxiv-2512-14071.creator: Shun Okumura 1,2,3 , Moritz M. Hirschmann 3 , and Yukitoshi Motome 1
arxiv-2512-14071.description: Abstract Spin spirals represent a fundamental class of noncollinear yet coplanar magnetic structures that give rise to diverse emergent phenomena reflecting spin chirality. We investigate metallic systems hosting commensurate spin spirals and uncover an unconventional anomalous Hall effect (AHE) induced by spiral magnetism.

europmc-pmc7404091.description: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent form of cell death characterized by intracellular lipid peroxide accumulation and redox imbalance. Ferroptosis shows specific biological and morphological features when compared to the other cell death patterns. The loss of lipid peroxide repair...

plos-pone-0355406.title: First report of Curvularia alcornii causing leaf spot of quinoa in Bangladesh
plos-pone-0355406.creator: Amit Hasan, Bilkis Nahar, Bodrun Nessa Shompa, Avizith Kumar Das, M Salahuddin M Chowdhury, F M Aminuzzaman, Md Rafiqul Islam, Md Nazrul Islam

pmc-10548877.title: Case report: Use of granulocyte-colony stimulating factor as an immunomodulatory therapy in a patient with neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder and comorbid immunodeficiency
pmc-10548877.creator: Gina S. Perez Giraldo, Edith L. Graham, Stephen VanHaerents, Roumen Balabanov
pmc-10548877.description: BackgroundAutoimmune diseases can coexist with immunodeficiency. We describe a treatment approach in which granulocyte-colony stimulating factor (G-CSF) is used to restore immune competence without worsening autoimmunity. G-CSF is a polyfunctional cytokine that influences survival, proliferation, and differentiation of hematopoietic stem cells, and has immunomodulatory effects on the innate and adaptive immune systems.

pmc-10574346.title: Ultrasound Assisted Coextraction of Cornicabra Olives and Thyme to Obtain Flavored Olive Oils
pmc-10574346.creator: Fátima Peres, Madalena Pinho Marques, Miguel Mourato, Luisa L Martins, Suzana Ferreira-Dias, Lorenzo Cecchi, Maria Bellumori
pmc-10574346.description: Flavoring olive oils is a new trend in consumer preferences, and different enrichment techniques can be used. Coextraction of olives with a flavoring agent is an option for obtaining a flavored product without the need for further operations. Moreover, ultrasound (US) assisted extraction is an emergent technology able to increase extractability.

pmc-11511236.title: Use of Low-Cost Sensors to Study Atmospheric Particulate Matter Concentrations: Limitations and Benefits Discussed through the Analysis of Three Case Studies in Palermo, Sicily
pmc-11511236.creator: Filippo Brugnone, Luciana Randazzo, Sergio Calabrese
pmc-11511236.description: The paper discusses the results of the concentrations of atmospheric particulate matter, in the PM2.5 and PM10 fractions, acquired by two low-cost sensors. The research was carried out from 1 July 2023 to 30 June 2024, in Palermo, Sicily. The results obtained from two systems equipped with the same sensor model were compared.

pmc-11673066.title: Anxiety and Academic Procrastination in Deaf and Hard of Hearing College Students: A Moderated Mediation Model
pmc-11673066.creator: Guomin Li, Zhiheng Xiong, Pingting Lin, Ilmari Määttänen, Gengfeng Niu
pmc-11673066.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Deaf and hard of hearing college students encounter unique challenges and pressures in their daily lives and academic pursuits, often leading to heightened anxiety levels, which may increase the likelihood of academic procrastination. This study aims to investigate the relationship between anxiety and academic procrastination in deaf and hard of hearing college students, with a focus on the mediating role of rumination and the moderating effect of psychological resilience.

pmc-11674412.title: Comparing Images from Near-Infrared Light Reflection and Bitewing Radiography to Detect Proximal Caries in Primary Teeth
pmc-11674412.creator: Aviv Shmueli, Avia Fux-Noy, Esti Davidovich, Diana Ram, Moti Moskovitz
pmc-11674412.description: Objectives: The present prospective study aimed to compare near-infrared light reflection (NIRI) and bitewing radiographs (BWR) images to detect proximal caries in primary teeth. Methods: 71 children underwent routine BWR, and scans were performed using an intra-oral scanner (iTero Element 5D, Align Technology, Tempe, AZ, USA), including a near-infrared light source (850 nm) and sensor.

pmc-12532562.title: Molecularly matched targeted therapies plus radiotherapy in glioblastoma: the phase 1/2a N2M2 umbrella trial
pmc-12532562.creator: Wolfgang Wick, Lisa-Marie Lanz, Antje Wick, Inga Harting, Susan Dettmer, Abigail K Suwala, Ralf Ketter, Ghazaleh Tabatabai, Corinna Seliger, Martin Glas, Michael C Burger, Marco Timmer, Florian A Ringel, Iris Mildenberger, Walter J Schulz-Schaeffer, Frank Winkler, Laila König, Christel Herold-Mende,
pmc-12532562.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Advances in molecular understanding and diagnostic precision of glioblastoma enable the identification of key genetic alterations in a timely manner and, in principle, allow treatments with targeted compounds based on molecular markers. Here we report the results of the phase 1/2 umbrella trial NCT Neuro Master Match (N2M2), which evaluated targeted treatments in 228 patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma without O6-methylguanine DNA-methyltransferase promoter hypermethylation.

pmc-13210364.title: Molecular Mechanisms and Metabolic Responses in the Biological Antagonism Between Trichoderma harzianum and Fusarium oxysporum
pmc-13210364.creator: Taozhen Chen, Keyang Tao, Yanguang Zhou, Hao Qian, Binchao Yu, Mingjiang Mao, Chendao Ruan, Xiaofeng Yuan
pmc-13210364.description: Trichoderma harzianum is an important biocontrol fungus widely used to manage vascular wilt caused by Fusarium oxysporum. However, the molecular regulation and metabolic responses underlying different confrontation modes remain unclear. In this study, we integrated non-targeted and targeted metabolomics, transcriptomics, mycotoxin detoxification assays, and RNA interference (RNAi) to systematically investigate antagonistic mechanisms under direct and indirect confrontation conditions.

pmc-13572642.title: Dysregulation of the GPX4/ACSL4 axis mediates ferroptosis in neurons of T2DD rats
pmc-13572642.creator: Yi Wang, Shuo Wang, Shuai Zhao, Yanli Lei, Yucheng Fan, Xinyi Zheng, Lan Yang, Yanmei Ma
pmc-13572642.description: IntroductionDiabetes mellitus complicated with depression (T2DD) is different from a single disease. It leads to more severe damage to nerve cells and cognitive dysfunction, and has a poor prognosis. Existing evidence indicates that ferroptosis—a form of programmed cell death driven by iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation—is involved in both diabetes and depression.
